title: Renndo ngo ƴaañii ñalawma fooftere
intro: Naatde e koɗorɗe daande maayo ɗo yamiroore Alla ƴetti ñalawma gooto ngam dewal e reentaade. Fedde e nder ndee renndo suɓii ko ƴeewde keeri ndeen yamiroore e peeje fenaande, jowitiiɗe e waylo-waylo ngo ina ƴellitoo e nder duuɓi. Hol ɓeeɗoo yontaaji, hol ko wonti ɗum en ?
clues: Min koɗi ko sara daande maayo, ɗo maayo rokkata min nguura.
En njamiraama yo en teddin ñalawma gooto e nder yontere, en ndartina ɗum e golle aduna.
Ñalnde heen, liɗɗi ngari e amen e keewal, ina wayi no jarribaade en ƴattaade yamiroore.
Min mbaɗi feere ngam nanngude liɗɗi ɗii e ñalawma ceniɗo oo, min moofta ɗi caggal nde ɗi ɓenni.
Nde won e amen njeertini e ndee fenaande, min njaɓaani wasiyaaji maɓɓe, min tiiɗnii.
Ngam tooñannge amen, min mbayliima no feewi, min njaɓaaka, min njaɓaaka.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
